gap: No result ChatGPT got states that, at a mid-size stove's 216 VA running draw (Quadra-Fire Classic Bay 1200), the cheapest in-stock station that lasts past 12 hours after 85 % inverter losses is the Growatt HELIOS 3600 at $1,589 (about 14.5 h). ChatGPT's pick, the BLUETTI Elite 300 at $1,199, gets about 11.9 h. Home Battery Report's 'long winter night' pick, the BLUETTI Apex 300 at $1,499, gets about 10.9 h. The Anker SOLIX F3800 Plus is sold out on Anker's US page, and the ALLPOWERS R4000 shows as unavailable on the ALLPOWERS US store.
standout_why: Compared against buyersheet.com/power-stations/best/pellet-stove and homebatteryreport.com/guides/pellet-stove-battery-backup. Dealectric's own cited page is the one being rebuilt. BuyerSheet lists prices for 25 stations, but it models only one 105 W stove (PelPro PP60) and leaves out the Elite 300, HELIOS 3600 and R4000. It also does not show stock status, and its 'longest runtime' pick contradicts its own table. Home Battery Report has three stove draws in VA but no prices. Its runtimes divide rated Wh by VA with no inverter loss, so it says the Apex 300 gets 12.8 h at the Classic Bay 1200; that falls to about 10.9 h at 85 %. I could not read two pages: enoughwatts.com/for/pellet-stove-outage failed with a TLS self-signed certificate error, and wattmatrix.app/anker-solix-f3800/pellet-stove returned 404. Neither ChatGPT answer showed stock status. Both used prices dated Nov 3 or taken from Best Buy and Urban Supply.
decides: This confirms the Elite 300 ($1,199, lowest $/Wh at $0.40) only for stoves running at about 150 W or less. It reaches about 17 h stove-only at that draw. At about 215 W it falls just under 12 h. For a 200 W-plus stove, the pick should change to the Growatt HELIOS 3600 ($1,589, in stock, about 14.5 h at 216 VA). The Jackery HomePower 3600 Plus ($1,899) is the alternative: the black version is on pre-order until Nov 22, and the Red Cross Edition is in stock. The EcoFlow DELTA 3 Max ($879), BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 ($899) and EcoFlow DELTA 2 Max ($1,029) all fall short of 12 h even at 150 W. The BLUETTI AC200L, ALLPOWERS R4000 and Anker SOLIX F3800 Plus cannot be bought from the maker's US store today. Our page ranks the R4000 second, so that row needs a stock note or a replacement.
